tasks.title: 60-sec intro v1 · Present → Past → Future (read once, then one take without looking)

lines.text: I'm an urban analytics graduate from HKU, and I work with geospatial data and Python.
lines.translation: 现在: 港大城市分析毕业，做地理空间数据

lines.text: Most recently, I worked as a research assistant on an ageing-friendly city project, where I built street view image datasets and analysed how older residents use open space.
lines.translation: 过去: 最近的研究助理经历

lines.text: Before that, I studied urban studies at Sheffield and trained at an architecture firm in Beijing.
lines.translation: 更早: 谢菲尔德本科 + 北京实习

lines.text: Data work comes naturally to me, especially turning messy spatial data into clear insights for planners.
Going forward, I'm looking to apply spatial analysis to real decisions, and I'm keen to bring my GIS and Python skills to this role.

tasks.prompt: 1) 60-sec intro, ONE take, Present→Past→Future, glance at most twice. Say ArcGIS (ark-JEE-eye-ess) if it comes up. 2) STAR #2 Situation + Task lines once, out loud (‘our regression needed a distance buffer…’ / ‘My job was to find out when and where…’).

questions.explain: Present (who you are) → Past (how you got here) → Future (why this role). 现在→过去→未来

options: Data work comes easier to me.
Data work comes naturally to me.
questions.explain: ‘comes easier’ needs a comparison (than…). Use ‘comes naturally’.

questions.explain: ark-JEE-eye-ess. Third time, the owl is watching.
